ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.

2. When practising Selective Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Selective Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Selective Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Selective Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Selective Listening.

3. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

4. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

5. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

8. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Conversational Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
